name: Jiangsu General Science Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Operating both within China and across international markets, Jiangsu General Science Technology Co., Ltd. specializes in the manufacturing and global distribution of tires. Its extensive product portfolio encompasses a diverse array of tire solutions, ranging from semi-steel radial and bias tires to specialized categories such as TBR (Truck and Bus Radial), PCR (Passenger Car Radial), and bias OTR (Off-the-Road). The company also provides tires specifically designed for light and heavy trucks, industrial machinery, and agricultural vehicles. Founded in 2002, the firm maintains its corporate headquarters in Wuxi, China. Furthermore, Jiangsu General Science Technology Co., Ltd. operates as a subsidiary of Hongdou Group Co.,Ltd.
